findings.summary: A stale reviewer export could be replayed across candidates because the retained prompt and final response were not derived from the exact candidate, revision, and gate values.
findings.resolution: Require canonical exact review prompt and final-response contracts derived from the bound candidate hash, source base, implementation commit, gate version, findings, and disposition.

findings.summary: Recompressed or otherwise mutated gzip bytes passed when their uncompressed raw bytes were unchanged.
findings.resolution: Bind both retained-file SHA-256 and uncompressed raw SHA-256, and cap decompression output before JSON parsing.

findings.summary: An explicit fork_turns=none value excused inherited pre-prompt turns in both role and production review validation.
findings.resolution: Require the exact review prompt to be the first retained message regardless of fork attestation, while still rejecting explicit fork mismatches.

findings.summary: Owner binding used substring phrases and did not fully validate root agent, publication role, completed task state, or designation semantics.
findings.resolution: Require an exact canonical approval contract and bind root/delegate agents, designation role, publication role, task status, parent, and chronology.

findings.summary: Review revocation and candidate pre-acceptance state were not completely enforced.
findings.resolution: Reject revoked reviews and require the exact candidate to remain non-consumable, unrevoked, unpublished, and pending review and owner approval.
